description: Send a draft to the approval queue. A draft with no time takes each account's next best slot (time_reason says why). Fails with VALIDATION if preflight finds a problem. A post already in the queue answers APPROVAL_REQUIRED (a person approves it in the app), unless this connection may publish what it submits (whoami: auto_approve) and made its last edit: then submitting again approves the edit, TikTok and YouTube still waiting for a person.

account_ids.description: Only these accounts' targets. Default: all.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

post_id.description: ID of the post (a UUID): from post_list or post_create

name: post_submit
title: Submit for approval
